classes.title: How Little Duet works
classes.parentTip: Watch together once before your first class.

segments.caption: Sit together
segments.parentCue: Sit beside your child, in front of the keys
segments.voice: Hi, friends. I'm your music teacher. Let's get ready to play together.

segments.caption: Sit in the middle
segments.parentCue: Stand the phone on the music stand, facing you both
segments.voice: Sit up tall, right in the middle of the piano.

segments.caption: You play
segments.voice: You are the piano player today.

segments.caption: Grown-up helps
segments.parentCue: You never need to play perfectly
segments.voice: Grown-up, you are the helper. Point, cheer, and guide a finger when needed.

segments.caption: Find two black keys
segments.parentCue: Use the pair nearest the middle
segments.voice: Find two black keys, side by side, in the middle of your piano.

segments.caption: This is C
segments.voice: Just to the left of the two black keys lives C.

segments.caption: Our home key
segments.parentCue: This is middle C. Check it is the one in the middle
segments.voice: This C in the middle is our home key. Put one finger on it.

segments.caption: Listen: C
segments.voice: Listen. This is how C sounds.

segments.caption: I listen
segments.parentCue: The app listens for single notes through the microphone
segments.voice: I listen for your notes. When you play the glowing key, I hear it.

segments.caption: We played it
segments.parentCue: No microphone? You tap the button after your child plays
segments.voice: Grown-up, if the microphone is off, tap We played it after each turn.

segments.caption: Soft round hand
segments.voice: Make a soft round hand, like holding a little ball.

segments.caption: Finger numbers
segments.parentCue: 1 is the thumb, 5 is the little finger
segments.voice: Your fingers have numbers. Your thumb is number one.

segments.caption: One to five
segments.parentCue: Touch each finger as you count
segments.voice: Wiggle each one with me. One, two, three, four, five.

segments.caption: The glowing key
segments.voice: When a key glows, that's the key to play.

segments.caption: Falling blocks
segments.parentCue: Coral blocks are your child's notes, blue ones are yours
segments.voice: Blocks fall down to the keys. When a block lands, play.

segments.caption: Watch
segments.voice: When you see the eye, it's watch time. Hands on your knees.

segments.caption: Watch
segments.voice: Watch my thumb play C.

segments.caption: Your turn
segments.voice: When you see the hand, it's your turn. I wait for you.

segments.caption: Together
segments.voice: When you see two friends, we play together, at the same time.

segments.caption: Bear low, bird high
segments.parentCue: High keys are on the right, for the little bird
segments.voice: Low keys, on the left, sound like a big bear.

segments.caption: Bear! Tap down low
segments.parentCue: Any key on the left counts
segments.voice: Tap any low key, down on the left.

segments.caption: Bird! Tap up high
segments.parentCue: Any key on the right counts
segments.voice: Now the little bird. Tap any high key, up on the right.

segments.caption: Tap the beat
segments.parentCue: Any key is fine. Tap with your child at first
segments.voice: When the circle grows, tap any key. Tap, tap, tap.

segments.caption: Pause or stop
segments.parentCue: We save your place, so you can come back later
segments.voice: Grown-up, pause at the top any time. Close stops the class.

segments.caption: Stars
segments.voice: At the end of each class, you get stars for playing together.

segments.caption: Mistakes are fine
segments.parentCue: There is never a fail sound. Cheer for trying
segments.voice: A different key just makes a new sound. That's fine. We try again.

segments.caption: Your first note
segments.voice: Now your very first note. Find C, our home key.

segments.caption: Your turn!
segments.parentCue: Point to C if your child needs help
segments.voice: Your turn. One finger, gentle press on C.

segments.caption: You did it!
segments.voice: I heard C! You played your very first note.

segments.caption: Ready to play
segments.parentCue: Pick a song from Home to start your first class
segments.voice: That's how Little Duet works. Now let's play a song together.
